name: trialbase
description: Clinical trials across registries (ISRCTN, ClinicalTrials.gov, CTIS) in one normalized schema: search trials, fetch one trial by id, resolve trials by identifier and read coverage. Each field carries its registry source and licence. Keyless clients are answered from a published evaluation sample, rate-limited per IP; full access is available with a bearer token or per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: trials_search
tools.description: Search trials across the registered trial registries.

tools.name: trials_get
tools.description: Fetch one trial in full, including its registry source and licence.

tools.name: trials_coverage
tools.description: Read the live coverage of the trial dataset.
